sections.problem: Construct adaptive prediction intervals with finite-sample validity.
sections.method: Combine quantile regression with conformal calibration.
sections.evidence: Empirical interval length reduction with maintained coverage.
sections.limitations: Coverage is marginal and depends on exchangeability assumptions.
sections.adaptation: Use calibrated uncertainty intervals as decision thresholds.

claims.text: CQR yields shorter intervals while preserving coverage.

evidence.text: Average interval length is shorter than split conformal in benchmark datasets.
